scenarios.expected_symptom: About 30% of POST /payments/process calls return 500, so some GET /orders requests fail at the gateway with 502 while others succeed. HighErrorRate fires on payments.
Every application request to payments returns 500 and every GET /orders at the gateway returns 502. Loki holds a deploy marker with git_sha=badc0de. HighErrorRate fires.
Each POST /payments/process takes 3s, so GET /orders takes about 6s at orders and the gateway. All requests still succeed. HighLatencyP99 fires on payments, orders and gateway.
Payments hangs for 30s, orders gives up after 10s and logs payments_call_failed with reason=timeout, and the gateway answers 504 after about 10s. HighLatencyP99 fires.
No alert fires. process_resident_memory_bytes{service_name="payments"} climbs by about 2 MiB per GET /orders because each order leaks 1 MiB on its payments call.
